newsitem.title: USA: Xerox plummets on NYSE after trading dealy.
newsitem.headline: Xerox plummets on NYSE after trading dealy.

text.p: Xerox Corp shares started New York Stock Exchange trade after a delay with a decline of almost 20 percent to 47-1/8.
The Xerox NYSE opening was delayed due to an order imbalance as sell orders flooded the floor, after Xerox blindsided investors with quarterly earnings that were far below expectations.
Before the opening, Xerox shares were indicated to trade at 45-1/2 to 48-1/2.
In subsequent minutes, the shares continued to fall, hitting 46-1/2, a 10-1/2 point decline.
